1. WAN WAN IS INTRODUCED AS THE FIERCE AND CAPRICIOUS QUEEN OF THE WOLF KINGDOM, A POWERFUL ENTITY WHOSE LOYALTY LIES SOLELY WITH HER OWN AMBITIONS.

6. DESPITE HER INITIAL SUCCESS, WAN WAN'S ARROGANCE AND LACK OF MORAL COMPASSION EVENTUALLY LEAD TO HER DOWNFALL AS THE HERO AND HIS ALLIES UNITE TO DEFEAT HER.
7. IN THE FINAL CONFRONTATION, WAN WAN FACES HER DEMISE, SERVING AS A CAUTIONARY TALE ABOUT THE DANGERS OF GREED AND THE INEVITABLE CONSEQUENCES OF EVIL.
8. HER LEGEND REMAINS ETCHED IN MEMORY AS ONE OF THE MOST ICONIC AND MEMORABLE VILLAINS IN CHINESE CINEMA, SYMBOLIZING THE PERILS OF ABUSE OF POWER.
